description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class FeaturesNotAccessibleException, which indicates that requested features of a Thing are inaccessible due to non-existence or permission issues. It includes methods for construction from JSON and message, and contains an inner Builder class for fluent instantiation.

classes.name: FeaturesNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating the requested features are not accessible due to non-existence or insufficient permissions.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing a FeaturesNotAccessibleException for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeaturesNotAccessibleException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeaturesNotAccessibleException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with new DittoHeaders.
